column1: # rule_provenance_note: A rule of the revised paper, which leaves urgency out of every primary calculation. It is not a result of the circulated paper.
# policy_role_note: The revised paper's primary list.

# normalization_anchors: secondary_participation (A): observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=50.4, p95=237.6; valid 17 of 17 | activity_scale (A): log1p of the value floored at 0, then observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=6.908754779315, p95=6.908754779315; valid 17 of 17 | conflict_exposure (A): log1p then observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=0, p95=0.262364264467; valid 17 of 17 | reach (R): log1p then observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=5.165668029816, p95=7.390501288877; valid 17 of 17 | aqi (Q): observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=27.2, p95=156.8; valid 17 of 17 | emissions (E): log1p then observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=1.918316218239, p95=7.744934489965; valid 17 of 17 | land (L): natural 0..1 fraction; natural 0..1 fraction; valid 17 of 17
# tie_rule: exact numeric score descending, then school name ascending in Unicode code point order
# sort_keys: score_point descending, then source_school_name ascending
# filters_effect: Filters only hide rows. Ranks, bounds and anchors are those of the full run.

# display_name: display_name is source_school_name with an apostrophe in front when the name starts with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return, ignoring any leading whitespace, so that a spreadsheet application does not read it as a formula. In the XLSX source_school_name is exact: use it to join and to rebuild the list. In the CSV it is guarded like every text cell (see csv_text_guard): join on school_key instead.

# csv_text_guard: In the CSV every text cell that starts with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return, ignoring any leading whitespace, has an apostrophe in front, so that a spreadsheet application does not read it as a formula. That covers source_school_name, province, district and locality as well as display_name. Numbers are not changed, and a negative number stays a number. To recover a value, remove one leading apostrophe when the text after it, ignoring leading whitespace, starts with one of those; a value that was stored with an apostrophe there already is ambiguous, so join on school_key. The XLSX stores every text cell as text and is not changed.
# k_meaning: k cuts the rule's full list: point rows have rank_point <= k, and range rows have a best possible rank (rank_best) <= k. Filters then hide rows; they never renumber a rank.

# range_school_convention: Range schools are interval schools: an environmental input is missing, so they have a score range and a rank range and no point rank or point score. They appear in their own rows (row_kind=range), after the point rows, ordered by best possible rank. They are not placed in the point order. The JSON list places them at their lower-score position by default, and at their upper-score position only when placement=upper is asked for as a labelled sensitivity.
# how_to_rebuild: Keep rows with row_kind=point. Sort by score_point descending, then source_school_name ascending in Unicode code point order. The result lists the rows in rank_point order.
# persistence_test: Lower top-20 frequency at least 0.8 in each of 3 settings, 5000 draws each. A frequency is a share of draws under declared scenarios, not a probability that a school needs help.
# persistence_limitation: This is the revised paper's six-component run. It is a revised sensitivity result, not an isolated estimate of urgency's effect.

# caveat: Research prototype for screening. The list orders existing school records for closer inspection. It does not establish condition accuracy, site safety, intervention benefit or an optimal investment portfolio. A missing input is unknown, not zero. Normalized AQI, reported greenhouse-gas emissions and modal land-cover classes are different contextual measures, and together they are not a validated health or hazard scale. Ranks have different scopes: read each with its scope label. Urgency is omitted because its primary measurement is inadmissible. A zero weight does not mean that no hazard was observed.
